name: Adriana Cabrera
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 2

items.text: Educator Adriana Cabrera is a former president of the Central Alameda Neighborhood Council. She co-founded a collective that she says has helped thousands of first-generation students. She wants to invest in student services, including financial aid, housing, child care and mental health. She aims to connect education to good-paying jobs and ensure community input on budgets. Cabrera proposes reviewing spending for efficiency and generating revenue without raising student costs.
